# The Membrane Palette

> A token-based design system and framework-free CSS component library where human warmth meets digital precision. Terracotta (human register) and deep teal (digital register) on warm cream, Fraunces + Instrument Sans + JetBrains Mono, automatic dark mode, WCAG contrast gate-checked at build time. Use it by linking one stylesheet and writing semantic HTML with `mp-` classes.

Rules for generating UI with this system:

- Load `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/idcesares/The-Membrane-Palette/membrane.css` (tokens + base + components). Load `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/idcesares/The-Membrane-Palette/components/membrane.js` only if you use Tabs, Tooltip Escape-dismiss, or need dialog invoker fallbacks.
- Compose from components (`.mp-button`, `.mp-card`, `.mp-field`…) and layout primitives (`.mp-container`, `.mp-stack`, `.mp-cluster`, `.mp-grid`) before writing CSS.
- Options are `data-*` attributes (`data-variant="secondary"`); only the values listed in the manifest exist.
- States come from semantic HTML/ARIA (`disabled`, `aria-invalid="true"`, `aria-current="page"`, `aria-selected`, `aria-busy`), never from extra classes.
- In custom CSS use semantic tokens only (`--color-text-primary`, `--color-bg-secondary`, `--color-action-primary`, `--space-6`, `--text-h2`). Never hex values, never Tier 1 primitives like `--color-terracotta`.
- At most one primary (terracotta) button per view. Cream not white, charcoal not black.

## Start here

- [Component manifest (JSON)](components/manifest.json): every component's classes, allowed attribute values, states, knobs, tokens and HTML examples
- [Design system specification](DESIGN-SYSTEM.md): principles, color, type, spacing, motion, dark mode, accessibility
- [Token source (DTCG JSON)](tokens/membrane.tokens.json): every token with descriptions; the only file with authority over values
- [Brand voice](BRAND-VOICE.md): tone and vocabulary for any copy you write alongside the UI

## Components

- [Layout](components/layout/README.md): Container, Stack, Cluster, Grid, Section and Surface primitives that compose any page without custom layout CSS.
- [Prose](components/prose/README.md): One class that styles long-form HTML — articles, Markdown output, CMS content — with the full typographic system.
- [Button](components/button/README.md): Pill-shaped action trigger. Primary is terracotta (one per view), secondary is a teal outline, ghost is quiet, danger is destructive.
- [Link](components/link/README.md): Text links — inline, quiet and standalone call-to-action — plus the skip link every page should start with.
- [Field](components/field/README.md): Wraps one form control with its label, hint and error message; Fieldset groups related controls under a legend.
- [Input](components/input/README.md): One class for text inputs, textareas and selects, with a ≥3:1 control boundary, visible focus ring, and invalid/disabled/read-only states.
- [Choice](components/choice/README.md): Checkbox and radio controls drawn in the brand style, inside a clickable .mp-choice label row with optional description.
- [Switch](components/switch/README.md): An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately — a native checkbox with role="switch".
- [Card](components/card/README.md): A contained unit — overline, serif title, body, footer, optional media — with standard, featured and flat variants and an accessible whole-card link.
- [Tag](components/tag/README.md): A pill that names a topic or category, colored by register — human (terracotta), digital (teal) or neutral. Can be a link, a toggle, or removable.
- [Badge](components/badge/README.md): A compact, uppercase, non-interactive label for status and metadata — info, success, warning, error, or a register tone.
- [Avatar](components/avatar/README.md): A person as a warm-filtered photo or Fraunces initials; digital tone uses monospace for bots and systems. Groups overlap.
- [Quote](components/quote/README.md): Blockquote with attribution in Fraunces italic; the pull variant renders the brand's signature phrases large and centered.
- [Code](components/code/README.md): Inline code, keyboard keys, and always-dark code blocks with gate-checked syntax colors that also style Prism and highlight.js output.
- [Divider](components/divider/README.md): A fading hairline between sections — or a full-width solid rule inside panels. Prefer whitespace first.
- [Table](components/table/README.md): Data tables with a quiet uppercase header, tabular numerals, end-aligned numbers, compact/striped/interactive variants and a scrolling frame.
- [Stat](components/stat/README.md): A headline metric — label, Fraunces numeral, and a delta whose arrow (trend) and color (sentiment) are set independently.
- [Alert](components/alert/README.md): An inline message about state — info, success, warning, error — or a human-register editorial note, with optional icon and actions.
- [Progress](components/progress/README.md): Native <progress> bars (determinate or indeterminate, three sizes, register tones) and a spinner for short unmeasured waits.
- [Tooltip](components/tooltip/README.md): A short inverse-colored hint shown on hover and keyboard focus — CSS-only, hoverable, Escape-dismissable with membrane.js.
- [Dialog](components/dialog/README.md): A modal built on native <dialog> — focus trapping, Escape and the backdrop come from the browser; header, body and footer slots.
- [Navbar](components/navbar/README.md): Sticky translucent site header with brand, uppercase links (aria-current marks the active page) and an actions slot; collapses by its own width.
- [Breadcrumb](components/breadcrumb/README.md): The path from site root to the current page, as an ordered list with decorative separators and aria-current on the last item.
- [Tabs](components/tabs/README.md): WAI-ARIA tabs — underline or pill (segmented) style; aria-selected drives the visuals, membrane.js adds click and arrow-key behavior.
- [Accordion](components/accordion/README.md): Expandable sections on native <details>/<summary> — no script, keyboard-ready, exclusive with a shared name, animated where supported.
